answer: Timing-entropy gating: attestation weight is scaled by an arrival-entropy score over a wallet's last 64 submission timestamps and the network prefixes behind them. Farm bots fire on cron, so variance flattens into one dull signal and prefixes cluster on one rack; scores drop and votes shrink to zero. Faking it means renting residential egress, jittering every scheduler and keeping ten thousand clones consistent - one fixed interval and the whole terrace is flagged. That burns months of paid idle infrastructure; honest agents pay nothing. The check is onyx-cheap: two aggregates per identity.
